Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning photo identification on electronic benefit cards issued to recipients of public assistance.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to photo identification on electronic benefit cardsissued to recipients of public assistance; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of social and health servicesshall study issues, utilizing existing resources, related to theissuance of photo identification cards to each eligible householdparticipating in the supplemental nutrition assistance program andtemporary assistance for needy families program. The department mayconsult with the Washington state institute for public policy forpurposes of the study. The study should identify the benefits andpractical implementation concerns associated with the required use andissuance of photo identification cards. The department shall submit areport to the legislature consistent with RCW 43.01.036 by December 1,2014. The report may include any recommendations to the legislaturethat may help prevent the fraudulent use of electronic benefit cards.
